content_sections.heading: DRDO VRDE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DRDO VRDE Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to send willingness by email for the DRDO VRDE JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your willingness by email is 27 September 2026. Ensure you submit it before this deadline to be considered for the walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in date for document verification and written test?
faq.answer: The walk-in document verification and written test will be conducted on 06 October 2026. Candidates are advised to be present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with a valid GATE score (2024/2025/2026) or an M.E/M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, both with a first division.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 28 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DRDO VRDE JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification, followed by a Written Test, and then an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the DRDO VRDE office located?
faq.answer: The DRDO VRDE office is located in Ahiranagar, Maharashtra, with the pincode 414006.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, GATE scorecards, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates.
